sections.surtitre: How we look after the place
sections.titre: Here, we look after the estate every day
sections.texte:
For us, ecology is not a selling point. It is simply how we look after the estate, day after day.

The tall trees had already had time to grow, so we simply opened 25 pitches in that setting, with no mobile homes and no entertainment programme, and we keep to simple habits.

items.texte: The drinking water is tested by an approved laboratory, and we use it sparingly: no car washing.
Glass, plastic, metal and paper are sorted at the recycling point along the track.
Garden waste goes into the two compost bins.
Stale bread and peelings go to the hens in the henhouse: nothing is wasted.
